style.styleTitle: Homcom Set of 3 3ft+4ft+5ft Pre-Lit Snowy Christmas Tree
style.toneOfVoice: Bring a snowy forest atmosphere indoors or outdoors with this HOMCOM 3-piece pre-lit pencil Christmas tree set (90/120/150 cm). Great as a set or placed separately, each tree features realistic PVC tips (130/180/250 tips) with snowy flocking. Pre-strung with warm white LEDs (50/100/150 lights), it offers 8 lighting modes via an IP44 waterproof battery box. These slim trees offer a safe display. . The 3-piece Christmas tree set includes small (90 cm), medium (120 cm) and large (150 cm) trees for versatile arrangements; . The PVC foliage provides shape retention and realistic appearance; . The pre-lit flocked Christmas trees are paired with 50/100/150 warm white LED lights for a cosy holiday display; . 8 dynamic lighting functions supported by an IP44 battery box (3 x AA batteries per tree, not included), creating a warm holiday atmosphere; . IP44 waterproof rating ensures safe use on porches, patios or gardens; . The slim pencil trees with small base fit in compact rooms, apartments, dorms, or entryways; . 2-section trunk design ensures reliable stability and convenient setup (30–45 minutes); . Colour: Green, White; . Light Colour: Warm White; . Material: PVC, Steel, Plastic; . Overall Dimensions: Small: F38 x 90H cm, Medium: F43 x 120H cm, Large: F48 x 150H cm; . Base Dimensions: Small: F11.5 x 11.5H cm, Medium: F15.5 x 15.5H cm, Large: F19.5 x 19.5H cm; . Tip Count: 130/180/250; . LED Light Count: 50/100/150; . Power Supply: Battery Operated (Requires 3 x AA batteries per tree, not included); . Item Label: 83C-330V00GN; . Shaping Note: In order to get a full appearance, please spread out all individual tips to get possible look.
